entities.summary: William Brooke Joyce, nicknamed Lord Haw-Haw, was an American-born fascist, Nazi, and Nazi propaganda broadcaster during the Second World War. After moving from New York to Ireland and subsequently to England, Joyce became a member of Oswald Mosley's British Union of Fascists (BUF) from 1932, before finally moving to Germany at the outset of the war where he took Nazi German citizenship in 1940.
